summary: An eight-track groovebox firmware with eleven engines to choose from per track, a 64-step sequencer and a song mode, laid out in the style of the OP-XY.
features: Seven synths including a 303, plus sampler, break slicer, drums, MIDI out
64 steps with step tricks, parameter locks, arp, strum and hold
Conductor track steps the song through a chord progression
Two send effects, mixer with EQ, master compressor, 93 presets
MIDI over USB, Bluetooth and TRS; USB host via powered hub
